basic_profile.bio: An economics enthusiast based in Montreal, Canada. I teach part-time at a local college and spend my evenings delving into the intricacies of macroeconomic trends. I'm passionate about gaming, especially titles that blend humor and strategy, like 'Fractured But Whole'. When I'm not working or gaming, I enjoy reading and discussing the nuances of the English language with fellow educators. I'm single and usually online late at night, given my nocturnal work habits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in Economics and have been teaching for over a decade. My expertise is further bolstered by continuous self-study and participation in online forums and communities. I'm also an active contributor to educational discussions, offering insights and advice based on both academic and practical experiences.
